meta.intensity_reason: France PA mandate under 8 weeks away (1 Sept 2026) with PA registration ~50% - Cegid closes EUR 1.1bn Shine acquisition (1M+ SMBs, 15,000 accountants across 7 markets) - Pennylane now live in Germany and valued at USD 4.25bn - converging FR/ES/DE/PT compliance deadlines
meta.ifyrne: Pennylane's confirmed H2 2026 entry into Spain and Cegid's aggressive 100-rep expansion in France significantly heighten competitive pressure as the critical French PA mandate (Sept 1, 2026) and Spanish Verifactu deadlines (Jan 2027) rapidly approach. Our stalled PA registration and the unresolved GE-Active sync remain critical internal risks, directly impacting our ability to capitalize on these mandates and prepare for Germany's XRechnung (Jan 2028) and Portugal's SAF-T (Jan 2027) obligations. Failure to address these foundational issues risks ceding significant market share to agile competitors like Pennylane in Spain and Cegid across France and Germany. Our single most important action this week is to secure Sage Active's PA registration and finalize the GE-Active sync, directly enabling our competitive response and ensuring compliance across WiSE.
meta.last_scan_summary: Manual deep refresh - data current as of 7 July 2026

summaries.DE: Market signals for Germany show significant competitive activity with Cegid's acquisition of sevdesk and DATEV's cloud migration, alongside the critical regulatory deadline for XRechnung e-invoicing compliance.
summaries.PT: Recent market signals in Portugal focus on upcoming regulatory changes for e-invoicing and SAF-T, alongside significant competitive consolidation with Cegid's acquisition of PHC Software.

signals.title: Cegid's acquisition of PHC Software strengthens its market position in Portugal
signals.body: Cegid Group reported a turnover of €85 million in Portugal in 2025, the year it acquired PHC Software. With operations fully integrated, Cegid expects a 10% growth this year. Cegid Primavera and PHC were considered unique in the Portuguese market, and Cegid is looking for further opportunities.
signals.implication: The integration of Cegid and PHC creates a more formidable competitor in Portugal, potentially impacting Sage's market share, especially if Cegid leverages this combined offering to target accountants.

signals.title: Germany's XRechnung mandate fully effective for all businesses by January 2028.
signals.body: Germany's B2B e-invoicing mandate, requiring all businesses to issue structured e-invoices, will be fully implemented by January 2028. While reception has been mandatory since January 2025, and issuance for larger companies since January 2027, the final deadline ensures universal compliance with XRechnung and ZUGFeRD formats.
signals.implication: Sage Active's PA-certified FR and Verifactu-certified ES compliance needs to be mirrored with robust XRechnung support for the German market to avoid penalties and maintain competitiveness.

signals.title: Cegid completes acquisition of sevdesk, appointing its CEO to lead DACH operations.
signals.body: Cegid has completed its acquisition of sevdesk, a German provider of cloud-based accounting software for SMBs. Marco Reinbold, sevdesk's CEO and co-founder, has been appointed General Manager for Cegid's DACH operations. Sevdesk serves over 130,000 customers in the DACH region.
signals.implication: Cegid's strengthened presence in the DACH region through sevdesk poses a direct competitive threat to Sage's SMB offerings in Germany, especially with integrated leadership driving expansion.

signals.title: DATEV begins cloud migration of core accounting and payroll modules in Autumn 2026.
signals.body: DATEV is migrating its on-premises software to cloud-based delivery, starting with its Kanzleimanagement module in Autumn 2026, followed by payroll, financial accounting, and tax modules. On-premises versions will be phased out over the coming years. This migration will alter interfaces and workflows for users.
signals.implication: This cloud transition by DATEV could impact the integration strategies for Sage for Accountants in Germany, potentially requiring adjustments to maintain seamless data flow and competitive positioning.

signals.title: Pennylane integrates digital wallet and payment features via Swan partnership
signals.body: Pennylane has partnered with Swan to embed a digital wallet functionality and enable digital payments directly within its platform. This integration, known as the Pennylane Wallet, allows for one-click bill payments and automated reconciliation, streamlining financial operations for businesses and accountants.
signals.implication: The enhanced banking and payment integration strengthens Pennylane's 'all-in-one' offering, potentially making it a more comprehensive solution than Sage's current offerings and increasing customer stickiness.

signals.title: Pennylane enhances AI capabilities with ComptAssistant and GenAI Analysis
signals.body: Pennylane has integrated advanced AI features, including 'ComptAssistant,' an AI chatbot for accounting firms, and 'GenAI Financial Analysis' for automated report insights. These features aim to automate accounting tasks and provide deeper financial insights, enhancing the platform's value proposition for accountants and SMEs.
signals.implication: Pennylane's continued investment in AI, particularly for accounting firms, directly challenges Sage's AI offerings and could attract firms seeking advanced automation and advisory tools.

signals.title: Holded Demonstrates Verifactu Readiness
signals.body: Holded, a Visma-owned platform with a strong customer base in Spain, has showcased early integration capabilities for the upcoming Verifactu mandate. Their focus on the Spanish market and existing user base suggests a potential advantage in capturing businesses seeking compliant solutions ahead of the 2027 deadlines.
signals.implication: Holded's progress in Verifactu integration could capture market share from businesses seeking immediate compliance solutions, impacting Sage Active's adoption rate if Sage's own integration is perceived as slower or less robust.

signals.title: Pennylane Accelerates Spain Entry, Targeting H2 2026 Launch
signals.body: Pennylane is reportedly finalizing its expansion into the Spanish market, with a planned launch in the second half of 2026. The French competitor, which has achieved significant ARR in its home market, is expected to target Spanish accounting firms (despachos) and the autónomo segment, potentially leveraging its existing platform and funding.
signals.implication: Pennylane's imminent entry into Spain poses a direct competitive threat to Sage for Accountants (SfA) Spain launch, especially if they gain traction before Sage. This requires a proactive and aggressive go-to-market strategy for Sage in Spain.

signals.title: Verifactu AEAT: New Guidance Issued for Compliance
signals.body: The Spanish Tax Agency (AEAT) has released updated guidance regarding the Verifactu mandate, effective January 2027 for corporations and July 2027 for self-employed individuals. The guidance clarifies technical requirements and reporting obligations, emphasizing the need for timely integration of compliant software solutions to avoid penalties of up to €50,000.
signals.implication: Sage Active and other Sage products must accelerate Verifactu integration and communication to ensure Spanish customers are prepared and compliant, mitigating risk of penalties and competitive disadvantage.

signals.title: Pennylane prepares for French e-invoicing mandate with accredited platform status.
signals.body: Pennylane is actively preparing for the mandatory French e-invoicing reform scheduled for September 1, 2026. The company has been registered as an Authorised Platform (PDP) and is enhancing its infrastructure to facilitate compliance for its users, including features for receiving and issuing electronic invoices. This positions Pennylane to capitalize on the regulatory shift, offering a compliant solution ahead of the deadline.
signals.implication: Pennylane's proactive approach to the French e-invoicing mandate, including its accredited platform status, presents a significant advantage and potential threat to Sage's ability to capture market share in France as businesses seek compliant solutions.

signals.title: Pennylane webinar highlights AI-driven automation and ComptAssistant for accounting firms.
signals.body: A May 2026 webinar showcased Pennylane's AI capabilities, including automated bank reconciliation, financial data centralization, and the ComptAssistant AI chatbot designed to help accounting professionals with technical questions and client advisory services. The platform also demonstrated features for automated invoice entry, VAT management, and expense reporting, emphasizing time savings and compliance with upcoming e-invoicing regulations.
signals.implication: Pennylane's continued investment in AI, specifically with tools like ComptAssistant, enhances its offering for accountants, potentially drawing them away from Sage solutions.

signals.title: Cegid Consolidates Market Position in Portugal with Primavera and PHC Acquisitions
signals.body: Cegid reported a turnover of €85 million in Portugal in 2025, the year it acquired PHC Software. With the integration of Primavera and PHC, Cegid aims to grow by 10% in 2026 and become an undisputed market leader across all segments. The company has a strong presence with 700 employees, 60,000 clients, and 300,000 users in Portugal and Lusophone Africa.
signals.implication: Cegid's aggressive expansion through acquisitions in Portugal, integrating Primavera and PHC, significantly strengthens their competitive position. Sage needs to monitor their go-to-market strategies and product integrations closely.

signals.title: Pennylane confirms PDP certification for French e-invoicing reform
signals.body: Pennylane has secured PDP (Plateforme de Dématérialisation Partenaire) certification from the DGFiP, making it compliant with the French e-invoicing reform. This certification enables Pennylane to handle the mandatory reception of electronic invoices from September 1, 2026, and issuance from September 1, 2027, for large companies and ETIs, and from September 1, 2028, for SMEs and micro-businesses.
signals.implication: Pennylane is fully prepared for the French e-invoicing mandate, reinforcing its competitive position and ability to attract firms concerned with compliance. This highlights a direct competitive threat to Sage's offerings in France.
signals.source: Hayot Expertise review of Pennylane (February 02 2026, updated May 2026)

signals.title: Cegid accelerates DACH expansion with sevdesk acquisition, targeting SMBs
signals.body: Cegid's acquisition of sevdesk, a German provider of digital invoicing and accounting solutions for SMBs, is a key step in its international growth strategy. Sevdesk serves over 130,000 customers in the DACH region and is focused on preparing businesses for upcoming e-invoicing reforms. Cegid aims to leverage sevdesk's platform to help businesses navigate digitalization and e-invoicing compliance.
signals.implication: Cegid's strengthened presence in the DACH market through sevdesk poses a direct competitive threat to Sage Active and Sage for Accountants. Their focus on SMBs and e-invoicing compliance aligns with upcoming German regulations, requiring Sage to highlight its own compliance and cloud capabilities in the region.
signals.source: sevdesk ist nun Teil von Cegid (February 06 2025), Sevdesk continues their success story together with Cegid - PwC (May 22 2025), Cegid - Sevdesk | Transaction Details - Houlihan Lokey (February 24 2025)

signals.title: Sage Active France emphasizes DGFiP compliance and cloud integration
signals.body: Sage Active in France is being highlighted for its cloud-based management solutions for SMEs, with a particular focus on its integration with Sage Network, a platform approved by the DGFiP (French tax authority). This positioning aims to assure French businesses of its compliance with upcoming regulatory requirements, such as the e-invoicing mandate.
signals.implication: Sage's emphasis on DGFiP compliance for Sage Active in France is a positive signal, but it needs to be clearly communicated to the market. The company should also monitor how competitors are leveraging AI and cloud technologies to enhance their offerings in this space.

signals.title: Pennylane and Cegid continue aggressive expansion in French accounting market
signals.body: Pennylane is actively engaging with accounting professionals through events like 'Les Rendez-Vous Pennylane' in February 2026, focusing on the impact of e-invoicing and AI on the profession. Cegid, a major player in French accounting software, is also noted for its strategic moves, including acquisitions and expanding its sales force, indicating a strong push to capture market share within the expert-comptable channel.
signals.implication: Increased competitive pressure from Pennylane and Cegid in the French market, particularly targeting the expert-comptable channel. Sage WiSE needs to differentiate its offerings and strengthen its relationships with French accountants to counter these moves.

signals.title: France's e-invoicing mandate deadline approaching: Businesses urged to prepare
signals.body: With the French e-invoicing mandate set to take effect on September 1, 2026, businesses are being strongly advised to prepare for the transition. The mandate requires all companies to receive electronic invoices, with larger companies also needing to issue them. Failure to comply can result in fines, emphasizing the urgency for businesses to adopt compliant solutions and for accounting professionals to guide their clients through this significant regulatory change.
signals.implication: Sage needs to ensure its French clients are fully aware of the upcoming mandate and have compliant solutions in place. Proactive communication and support are crucial to avoid client churn and maintain market position.

signals.title: Cegid Primavera Strengthens Market Position in Portugal
signals.body: Cegid continues to integrate and expand its offerings in Portugal, notably with Cegid Primavera, which is described as a reference ERP with AI that adapts to businesses. Cegid also offers solutions for accounting firms and fiscal automation. The company aims to be a leader in all segments and markets where it operates, with plans to double its business volume by 2026 through organic growth and acquisitions.
signals.implication: Cegid's continued investment and market presence in Portugal, particularly with its AI-enhanced offerings, represents a growing competitive threat. Sage should monitor Cegid's specific product developments and market penetration strategies.

signals.title: Portugal Delays Qualified Electronic Signature and SAF-T Accounting File Mandates
signals.body: Portugal has postponed the requirement for Qualified Electronic Signatures (QES) on e-invoices to January 1, 2027. Additionally, the mandatory periodic submission of the SAF-T accounting file has been delayed to 2028, covering the 2027 fiscal year. These changes were confirmed with the approval of the 2026 Draft State Budget.
signals.implication: This provides a slight buffer for adoption of QES and SAF-T accounting, but the underlying regulatory drivers remain. Sage needs to ensure its solutions are ready for these deadlines and continue to monitor any further changes.

signals.title: Pennylane secures €175M for AI focus and European expansion, including Spain
signals.body: Pennylane has raised €175 million, led by TCV, with a strategic focus on expanding its AI capabilities and accelerating its European growth, which includes Spain. The funding will be used to automate financial and accounting processes.
signals.implication: Pennylane's significant funding and AI focus pose a direct competitive threat in Spain, especially as they are set to enter the market before Sage Active Spain's full launch. Sage needs to counter with its own AI advancements and a strong value proposition for the Spanish market.

signals.title: Verifactu deadlines confirmed for Jan 2027 (corporate) and July 2027 (self-employed)
signals.body: The Verifactu system will become mandatory for legal entities (corporations) on January 1, 2027, and for individuals (self-employed) on July 1, 2027. Businesses must ensure their invoicing software generates structured, hash-chained records that guarantee data integrity and include a QR code on each invoice.
signals.implication: This confirms the critical timeline for Verifactu compliance. Sage must accelerate its efforts to ensure SfA Spain is fully Verifactu-compliant and that customers are aware of the upcoming deadlines.
signals.source: Multiple sources (e.g., Vertex AI Search results 3, 5, 9)

signals.title: Holded emphasizes Verifactu compliance in its platform
signals.body: Holded is actively promoting its platform's readiness for Spain's Verifactu regulation, highlighting features like automatic invoice signing and real-time reporting to the AEAT. They are positioning themselves as a solution for businesses to comply with Verifactu requirements out-of-the-box.
signals.implication: Holded is a strong competitor in the Spanish market, particularly for SMEs and freelancers needing to comply with Verifactu. Sage needs to ensure its offering is equally robust and clearly communicated.

signals.title: Germany's B2B e-invoicing obligation begins in 2025, with XRechnung gaining importance
signals.body: While XRechnung has been mandatory for B2G transactions since 2020, the B2B e-invoicing obligation in Germany starts gradually from 2025 through 2028. Although not universally mandatory for B2B, XRechnung is gaining importance as companies adapt to future regulatory requirements.
signals.implication: Sage must ensure its products are fully compliant with XRechnung and other e-invoicing standards to meet the upcoming B2B mandate, as non-compliance could lead to significant fines and loss of business.
signals.source: XRechnung Guide: Germany's B2B E-Invoice Standard Explained (2026) - Invoicemonk (March 24, 2026)

signals.title: Pennylane continues to gain traction with French accounting firms
signals.body: Pennylane is actively promoting its platform to French accounting firms, with a stated goal of becoming the preferred management platform for European accountants and their clients. Recent discussions show accounting firms specifically seeking to use Pennylane for their practice management.
signals.implication: Pennylane's continued growth and focus on the expert-comptable channel in France represent an ongoing competitive threat, potentially diverting firms and their clients away from Sage's offerings.
signals.source: Pennylane: Plateforme tout-en-un de gestion financière & comptabilité, May 2024

signals.title: Cegid EBP strengthens expert-comptable channel with new sales reps
signals.body: Cegid is reportedly adding 100 new sales representatives in Q2 2026 specifically targeting the expert-comptable channel in France. This move by Cegid, in partnership with EBP, aims to bolster their presence and offerings within the French accounting professional market.
signals.implication: This aggressive expansion by Cegid/EBP into the expert-comptable channel in France poses a direct threat to Sage's existing relationships and market share within this segment, potentially impacting SfA's performance.
signals.source: Cegid+Shine+EBP (FR/ES/PT/DE — 100 new FR sales reps Q2 2026)

signals.title: Sage Active France ready for e-invoicing mandate
signals.body: Sage Active Essentials is confirmed to be compliant with the upcoming French e-invoicing mandate, offering features for regulatory compliance and collaboration with accountants. The promotion for this service is valid until June 30, 2026.
signals.implication: Sage is positioning Sage Active as a compliant solution for the French market ahead of the September 1, 2026 mandate, which could impact SfA's market share if not adequately addressed.

signals.title: OCC emphasizes accountant's role in economic growth and compliance
signals.body: The Ordem dos Contabilistas Certificados (OCC) highlights the crucial role of certified accountants in supervising, training, and ensuring the ethics of accounting professionals, thereby guaranteeing the reliability of financial information. They assist SMEs in optimizing resources, strategic planning, and tax compliance, contributing to national economic growth.
signals.implication: The OCC's continued emphasis on the accountant channel reinforces its importance for Sage for Accountants (SfA) in Portugal. Understanding and aligning with OCC's initiatives could be key to channel success.

signals.title: Cegid Primavera focuses on Cloud ERP for new implementations in 2026
signals.body: Cegid Primavera's strategy for 2026 emphasizes their Evolution Cloud (SaaS) version for new implementations, positioning it as the recommended deployment. This move aims to consolidate their market presence, especially with legacy v9 versions nearing end-of-support.
signals.implication: Cegid's push towards cloud solutions in Portugal could intensify competition for Sage Active, especially if Sage's cloud offerings are not perceived as equally advanced or integrated.

signals.title: Portugal extends PDF invoice validity to end of 2026; QES mandatory from Jan 2027
signals.body: Portugal has postponed the requirement for a Qualified Electronic Signature (QES) on PDF invoices. Standard PDF invoices will be accepted until December 31, 2026. From January 1, 2027, all electronic invoices not exchanged via EDI must include a QES to be considered valid. This also impacts the SAF-T accounting file submission, now due in 2028 for the 2027 fiscal year.
signals.implication: This extension provides a slight buffer for SAF-T accounting compliance but reinforces the need for QES adoption by early 2027. Sage Active's PA-certification in FR might need to be reviewed for PT implications.

signals.title: Germany's B2B e-invoicing mandate enters transitional phase from 2025-2028.
signals.body: Starting January 1, 2025, German B2B companies are required to receive and process e-invoices. While non-standard electronic invoices and paper invoices are accepted through 2026, the mandate for issuing standard e-invoices (XRechnung) becomes progressively stricter, with only e-invoices permitted from 2028. This is part of the Growth Opportunities Act (Wachstumschancengesetzes).
signals.implication: The phased introduction of B2B e-invoicing in Germany creates an urgent need for compliance solutions. Sage Active and SfA must ensure their offerings fully support XRechnung and the transition timelines to avoid clients facing penalties and to capture market share.
signals.source: Mandatory e-invoicing in Germany - Stripe (January 30, 2025), XRechnung e-Invoicing Format? How to Create, Examples, Specifications - ClearTax (March 24, 2026)

signals.title: DATEV initiates largest portfolio transformation, moving core applications to the cloud in 2026.
signals.body: DATEV is undergoing its most significant portfolio transformation in history, with core on-premises solutions gradually phasing out and migrating to the cloud. This includes MyDATEV Kanzlei, DATEV Kanzleimanagement, and DATEV Rechnungswesen in the cloud (H2 2026). The transition is expected to take 24-36 months for tax firms, presenting both risks and opportunities for modernization and AI integration.
signals.implication: This cloud shift by DATEV, a dominant player in the German tax advisor market, necessitates a strategic response. Sage needs to understand how this impacts SfA's integration and competitive positioning, especially if DATEV's cloud offerings become more attractive to tax firms.
signals.source: DATEV Cloud-Migration 2026: Was Kanzleien bedenken müssen (April 23, 2026)

signals.title: France's E-invoicing Mandate Approaches: Businesses Must Use Certified Platforms by Sept 1, 2026
signals.body: France is implementing a mandatory e-invoicing system starting September 1, 2026. All businesses will be required to use state-certified platforms for issuing and receiving electronic invoices and reporting transaction data. This reform aims to combat fraud, improve cash flow, and streamline daily management for over 10 million economic actors. Companies must designate a certified platform to ensure compliance.
signals.implication: Sage must ensure its solutions are either certified platforms or fully compatible with them to avoid clients facing penalties and to maintain market share.

signals.title: France's electronic invoicing mandate deadline approaching; platform readiness is key.
signals.body: With the French electronic invoicing mandate set for September 1, 2026, businesses and accounting firms are urged to choose and implement an accredited platform. As of early July 2026, over 137 platforms have been accredited by the DGFiP. Failure to comply by the deadline carries penalties, including a €15 fine per non-compliant invoice. While reception compliance is mandatory for all VAT-paying businesses by September 1, 2026, issuance compliance for larger companies begins on the same date, with smaller businesses following in September 2027.
signals.implication: This regulatory deadline is a critical driver for adoption of compliant software. Sage must ensure its solutions (SfA, Sage Active) are fully compliant and actively communicate this to the market, highlighting any accredited platform integrations. The risk of non-compliance for customers is high.

signals.title: Cegid-EBP alliance strengthens French market presence with dedicated sales efforts.
signals.body: The Cegid and EBP integration is actively pursuing the French market, with EBP, now part of Cegid, offering specialized solutions for accounting firms. Recent promotions target members of the CJEC (a French accounting body), indicating a focused sales push. Cegid's acquisition of EBP aims to create a European leader in SMB/TPE management software, with a strong emphasis on the French market and the upcoming electronic invoicing reform.
signals.implication: The combined strength of Cegid and EBP, backed by dedicated sales efforts and a focus on the French accounting sector, represents a significant competitive challenge. Sage needs to monitor their market penetration closely and differentiate its offerings, particularly in light of the PA mandate.

signals.title: Pennylane intensifies focus on French accountant channel with new features and partnerships.
signals.body: Pennylane is actively targeting the French accountant market, emphasizing its collaborative platform for real-time data sharing between businesses and accountants. Recent updates highlight features for managing multiple client files and a growing network of over 4,500 accounting partners. The company is also positioning itself to address the upcoming electronic invoicing mandate in September 2026.
signals.implication: Pennylane's aggressive expansion in the French accountant channel poses a direct competitive threat to Sage for Accountants (SfA) in France. Sage needs to accelerate its own channel strategy and product roadmap to counter Pennylane's momentum.

signals.title: Germany's B2B e-invoicing mandate to be fully implemented by 2028.
signals.body: While XRechnung has been mandatory for B2G (business-to-government) invoices since November 2020, Germany's B2B e-invoicing obligation begins in 2025 with transitional periods extending through 2028. From 2025-2026, non-standard electronic and paper invoices will be accepted alongside e-invoices. This will be limited to companies with a turnover below €800,000 in 2026, and from 2028, only e-invoices will be permitted.
signals.implication: The upcoming B2B e-invoicing mandate is a critical deadline for all businesses operating in Germany. Sage must ensure its products are fully compliant with XRechnung and other relevant e-invoicing standards to avoid penalties and maintain market relevance. Proactive communication and support for customers navigating this transition will be key.
signals.source: Mandatory e-invoicing in Germany - Stripe (January 30 2025), XRechnung e-Invoicing Format? How to Create, Examples, Specifications - ClearTax (March 24 2026)

signals.title: Spain's autónomo rates frozen at 2025 levels for 2026
signals.body: Proposed increases to Spain's autónomo (self-employed) rates for 2026 were scrapped due to significant backlash. Rates remain frozen at 2025 levels, with monthly contributions ranging from approximately €206 to €607. The only minor change is a slight increase in the MEI surcharge from 0.8% to 0.9%. New freelancers can still benefit from the €80/month 'tarifa plana' for the first 12 months.
signals.implication: While not a direct threat, stable autónomo costs may encourage more individuals to start businesses, potentially increasing the market for SMB accounting solutions. Sage Active should monitor any shifts in this segment.

signals.title: Portugal Mandates Qualified Electronic Signature (QES) for PDF Invoices from January 1, 2027
signals.body: PDF invoices will require a Qualified Electronic Signature (QES) to be considered valid for fiscal purposes starting January 1, 2027. Until December 31, 2026, PDF invoices will continue to be accepted without this requirement. This mandate applies to all non-EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) invoices.
signals.implication: This regulatory change presents a clear deadline for Sage to ensure its Portuguese offerings support QES for PDF invoices. Failure to comply could lead to non-compliant customer solutions and competitive disadvantage against solutions that are already QES-ready.

signals.title: Holded certified for Verifactu, Sage 50/200 also listed
signals.body: Holded is among the accounting software providers that have achieved Verifactu certification as of June 2026. Sage 50/200 (Spain) is also listed as certified, indicating readiness for the upcoming mandate.
signals.implication: Holded's certification highlights a competitive player already compliant with Verifactu. Sage's own certification for Sage 50/200 in Spain is positive, but reinforces the need to ensure Sage Active is also Verifactu-ready for this market.
signals.source: Holded, Sage 50/200 (Spain), A3 Software, Contasimple, and FacturaDirecta are all certified as of June 2026

signals.title: Pennylane Poised for Spanish Market Entry Amidst French Success
signals.body: Pennylane, a significant competitor in France with €115M ARR, is preparing for its launch in the Spanish market in H2 2026. This expansion, following its established presence in France and Germany, signals a broader European competitive push.
signals.implication: Potential for Pennylane to gain early traction in Spain before Sage for Accountants Spain launches, necessitating accelerated go-to-market planning for SfA Spain.
